purpose: Test whether the midpoint-quadratic readout of the grouped MLP6--7 source is a predictive and manipulable tensor program at unseen interpolation and extrapolation gains.

binding_evidence.finding: At the registered t=1 endpoint, midpoint JVP predicts the exact grouped-unit head delta with cosine at least 0.999927, relative error at most 0.013932, and installed opposite-number task recovery in [0.959081,1.046326]; endpoint JVP fails.

novelty_audit: No receipt uses the frozen endpoint and midpoint derivatives to predict unseen gain manipulations of this causal source without fitting to those gains.
This is an intervention-level prediction of head vectors and native-tail task effects, not a rank, compression, reconstruction, or semantic-uniqueness claim.
map: For each existing HOLDOUT row, source in {opposite-number, same-number lexical}, and background in {recipient: empty-to-YZ, donor-context: EAUW-to-EAUWYZ}, let d=x1-x0 and g(t)=f(x0+t d). Freeze b=J_f(x0)d and c=J_f(x0+d/2)d-b from the prior endpoint/midpoint construction. Predict g_hat(t)=f(x0)+t b+t^2 c at registered gains t in {-0.5,0.5,1.5}; compare with exact g(t), install both into the native tail, and score head geometry plus task-margin recovery.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_closure: All replay, no-op, state, normalized-state, and finite-tensor gates are at most 5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_quadratic_head_prediction: For every opposite-number source/background/cell/gain, predicted-versus-exact head-delta cosine is at least 0.98 and relative error is at most 0.10.
predictions.pred_c_quadratic_task_manipulation: For the same cells, installed predicted task-margin recovery relative to the exact gain intervention is in [0.80,1.20] with the exact sign.
predictions.pred_d_extrapolation_stable: Predictions b and c hold separately at both extrapolation gains -0.5 and 1.5.
predictions.pred_e_lexical_effect_bounded: At every background/cell/gain, absolute lexical exact and predicted task-margin effects are at most 25% of the matched opposite-number exact effect. This preserves, rather than repairs, the parent specificity discriminator.

null: If the instrument holds but the quadratic law fails at unseen gains, retain the midpoint result only as an endpoint secant identity and move to exact operational equivalence classes; do not add polynomial degree or tune gains post hoc.

price.backwards: two JVPs per source/background; no optimization

closed_claims: necessity outside the fixed L11H3 interface
